name: Buyers or agents reluctant to provide information
description: Parties avoid face-to-face contact, deal via representatives or insist on speed.
fp: May have innocent explanations; assess in context of customer profile and other indicators.

sources.text: FATF, Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing Through the Real Estate Sector (2007)
FATF and Egmont Group, Concealment of Beneficial Ownership (2018)
FATF, Guidance for a Risk-Based Approach: Real Estate Sector (2022)
